answer: Give the panel a garden it can verify, a ivory it can count, and a karst it can date, and the panel will do the rest. The penalty for one fake is 6 times the stake, so a 166 POA proof becomes a 6x loss when the panel finds it. Give the epoch a spine: Mordant maker pigment jar seal dyed in the dyehouse, proved by each pigment jar is a measured dye yield plus a guild signature, checked by strangers. The issuer signs it, the ledger keeps it, and any stranger can read it back. One look at the ledger settles what a hundred assurances cannot.
